# dottype

> Generate C# types from example JSON, CSV, or Parquet data using the dottype CLI or the dottype.Build NuGet package.

Start with the usage reference. It covers the shared argument contract and the differences between the CLI, single-file apps, project properties, and Visual Studio. Install dottype and dottype.Build version 0.2.0 from NuGet. There is no public runtime inference API.

## Documentation

- [Usage reference](USAGE.md): Installation, all arguments and defaults, CLI tab completion setup, equivalent examples, sampling, IntelliSense, and troubleshooting.
- [Quick start](README.md): Installation and minimal examples for each entry point.

## Optional

- [Source repository](https://github.com/DouglasCleghorn/dottype): Source, examples, changelog, and repository instructions for contributors.
